why: In CO-S29 (lines 1718-1719), an agent question that states the full proposal and offers the whole order matches both the optional pair and the confirmation-form pair. §5.1 only says which pair wins when several confirmation-form pairs are in scope, so whether the turn gets the confirmation label depends on which answer the simulator gives. Separately, failure row line 95 ('propose nothing until the customer asks') is stricter than CO-03 line 68 ('proposes nothing else'), and both cover the same case.
